Market today: Cautious mood for tech/chips. A spreading chip rout is the main driver, despite some broader market calm. IMF warnings on bond yields and global resilience add to the underlying uncertainty.

Your holdings: MUU (-16.32%), SOXL (-42.87%), and SPAL (-21.35%) are all flagged "SELL." These leveraged ETFs are below their stops, amplifying losses on margin. The chip rout directly impacts MUU and SOXL.

Watch: Monitor the spread of the chip rout and any further commentary on bond yields. Pay close attention to your leveraged positions.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged chip holdings in this volatile environment.
plays: MUU is below its 31.6 stop. Consider trimming this leveraged chip ETF to manage risk, especially with the spreading chip rout.
SPAL is below its 21.38 stop. Review and consider trimming this leveraged ETF to protect capital.
SOXL is significantly below its 200 stop. Re-evaluate your stop loss for this highly leveraged chip ETF given its deep drawdown.
